title: The WordPress showcase-nav map removes a kit screen linked only from a template part's mega menu (Tracy Business wp7)
steps: S1: node --test scripts/test/build-wordpress-showcase-nav.test.mjs — the generator over Tracy Business and Tracy Base header template parts, plus synthetic markup
expect: S1: Tracy Business — the Style guide link reached only from the header mega menu gets a templatePart.removeBlock op; the other entries stay
S1: a kit screen also linked from a navigation entry follows that entry, with no second op
S1: a kit screen in the markup that is not a list item of its own is a question, not removed
S1: Tracy Base Typography with no inventory.json is unresolved route-not-proven, not removed
evidence: 25/10/2026 QA: tracy-business wp7 1.3.8 showcase-nav-map had operations 0, kept 615; on a real site apply completed and Style guide stayed in the header
fence: only kit-screen links outside navigation blocks, with no entry opening the same target and a proven route, are removed

tests: Tracy Business: a kit screen the header links only from its mega menu leaves it, the other entries stay
a kit screen linked from the markup and from a navigation entry follows the entry
a kit screen in the markup that is not a list item of its own is a question
Tracy Base: Typography, linked only from the header mega menu, is judged a kit screen
